meta.currency_note: The model uses CHF-equivalent internal units for continuity with the original calculation workflow. Reporting columns in EUR and USD are added using explicit conversion factors in run_full_eu27_uk_ch.py. The economic values below are screening assumptions derived from the cited public sources and are used as uncertainty ranges, not as site-specific quotations.
meta.no_ghost_number_note: Each numerical input is accompanied by a public source URL and a short derivation/provenance note. Where no harmonised public value is available, the parameter is either excluded from the base model or explicitly treated as a scenario assumption.
meta.no_hidden_credit_note: No co-product or by-product credit is subtracted from delivered cost in the base model. The output explicitly reports coproduct_credit_chf_per_tonne_saf and annual_coproduct_credit_chf, both zero unless intentionally changed in a scenario.
meta.v6_note: v6 additions: (1) fixed_land_and_utilities_chf_per_year, previously a hidden 60 MCHF/y constant in economics.py, is now an explicit scenario parameter so it appears in provenance and uncertainty sampling; (2) h2_storage_capex_chf_per_kwh is now an explicit parameter used consistently for BOTH the seasonal store and the plant H2 buffer (the old 12 CHF/kg buffer value was internally inconsistent with the 2.4 CHF/kWh = 80 CHF/kg seasonal value); (3) an optional meta.fx_to_chf mapping plus per-parameter 'currency' tags allow USD/EUR source values to be converted explicitly instead of being relabelled as CHF 1:1 (see review finding P16). Without these tags behaviour is unchanged.

fx_to_chf_example.comment: To activate explicit FX conversion, rename this key to fx_to_chf, set rates for a stated date (e.g. ECB reference rates), and tag parameters with 'currency': 'USD'.

pv_capex_chf_per_kw.source: IEA Levelised Cost of Hydrogen Maps. The 2030 technology CAPEX assumptions reported by IEA include USD 380-1300/kW for solar PV; these are used as a CHF-equivalent screening range.

wind_capex_chf_per_kw.source: IEA Levelised Cost of Hydrogen Maps. The 2030 technology CAPEX assumptions reported by IEA include USD 980-3260/kW for onshore wind; these are used as a CHF-equivalent screening range.

battery_capex_chf_per_kwh.source: IRENA Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2024 reports utility-scale battery storage costs around USD 192/kWh; the base and upper bound add conservative screening margin.

electrolyser_capex_chf_per_kw.source: IEA Levelised Cost of Hydrogen Maps and IEA Electrolysers tracking page. IEA LCOH Maps include USD 620-960/kW 2030 electrolyser CAPEX; the upper bound reflects current installed-cost uncertainty from IEA tracking material.

dac_capex_chf_per_tco2_year.source: NREL DAC review summarising the wide range of reported direct-air-capture cost and capital assumptions; used here as a proxy uncertainty band rather than a vendor quotation.

ft_capex_chf_per_kw_liquid.source: Screening engineering range for Fischer-Tropsch/liquid synthesis checked against EASA ReFuelEU synthetic aviation fuel reference-price plausibility. It is retained as an uncertainty parameter rather than a plant quote.

heat_pump_capex_chf_per_kw.source: Scenario range for auxiliary heat integration; technology context from IEA Energy Efficiency 2024. This is a minor cost item relative to renewables and electrolysis.

compressor_capex_chf_per_kw.source: Scenario range for compression equipment; technology context from IEA The Future of Hydrogen. This is a minor cost item relative to renewables and electrolysis.

pipeline_capex_chf_per_km.source: Pipeline linehaul proxy derived from public pipeline-cost benchmarks. Global Energy Monitor summarises FERC/OGJ gas pipeline projects around USD 4.75 million/km in 2015-16; a lower-to-central screening range is used here for liquid-fuel logistics sensitivity.

road_variable_chf_per_tkm.source: Government fuel-supply-chain benchmark: Freight Australia reports refined fuel road freight rates of about AUD 0.13 per tonne-kilometre; converted approximately to a CHF-equivalent screening range.

airport_terminal_and_tankage_chf_per_yea.source: Not monetised in the base screening model because airport tankage and hydrant costs are highly site-specific. IATA guidance confirms that airport fuel storage capacity must be assessed from airport-specific operating assumptions; this term is therefore excluded rather than represented by an unsupported generic value.

wacc.source: Scenario finance range used for infrastructure screening and sensitivity analysis; consistent with the use of WACC as a key parameter in levelised-cost analysis such as IEA LCOH Maps.

coproduct_credit_chf_per_tonne_saf.source: No co-product credit is applied in the base model. This parameter is retained explicitly at zero to avoid an unsupported cost offset.

fixed_land_and_utilities_chf_per_year.source: Internal screening assumption for land lease, utilities, insurance and site services of a ~4 GW-scale PtL complex. Previously hard-coded (60 MCHF/y ~= 81 CHF/t SAF) with no provenance entry; now explicit so it is visible, sampled, and flagged for replacement with a sourced value.

h2_storage_capex_chf_per_kwh.source: Screening range for bulk hydrogen storage spanning geological (salt-cavern) storage at the low end to small above-ground pressurised storage at the high end; the base keeps the original model value (2.4 CHF/kWh = 80 CHF/kg H2). Site-specific - replace with a sourced value (e.g. IEA/BNEF hydrogen storage cost surveys) before publication.

synthetic_saf_reference_eur_per_tonne_20.source: EASA 2025 aviation fuel reference prices for ReFuelEU Aviation synthetic aviation fuels
